Nhãn điều khiển (giao diện en): Advisory Line 17 The pod uses the default service account. Fix: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount with the minimum RBAC and set serviceAccountName.
Advisory Line 18 Container "web" does not drop ALL capabilities. Fix: Add capabilities.drop: ["ALL"] and add back only what is required.
Advisory Line 18 Container "web" does not set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false (the default allows it). Fix: Add securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation: false.
Advisory Line 18 Container "web" has a writable root filesystem. Fix: Add securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and mount emptyDir volumes for writable paths.
Advisory Line 18 Container "web" has no CPU limit. Fix: Set resources.limits.cpu.
Advisory Line 18 Container "web" has no CPU request. Fix: Set resources.requests.cpu.
Advisory Line 18 Container "web" has no livenessProbe. Fix: Add a livenessProbe so Kubernetes restarts stuck containers.
Advisory Line 18 Container "web" has no memory limit. Fix: Set resources.limits.memory.
Advisory Line 18 Container "web" has no memory request. Fix: Set resources.requests.memory.
Advisory Line 18 Container "web" has no readinessProbe. Fix: Add a readinessProbe so traffic only reaches ready pods.
Advisory Line 18 Container "web" has no seccompProfile (RuntimeDefault recommended). Fix: Add securityContext.seccompProfile.type: RuntimeDefault (pod or container level).
Advisory Line 18 Container "web" is not forced to run as non-root (runAsNonRoot). Fix: Add securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true (and a numeric runAsUser).
Cross-check resources (Service selector, ports, duplicate names)
Ignore kinds that have no schema (hide the "unsupported kind" warning)
Look up custom resources (CRDs) in the community catalog (Datree)
